item.title: 首款触屏 MacBook Pro 周四登场
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Apple will release its first touchscreen MacBook Pro this Thursday. This product will be launched as a higher-end MacBook Pro, with a similar appearance to the current model but lighter, featuring a high-contrast OLED display, marking the first time OLED is used in a Mac. 据彭博社报道，苹果将于本周四发布首款触控版 MacBook Pro。这款产品将以更高端的 MacBook Pro 形态推出，外观与现款相近但重量更轻，采用高对比度 OLED 显示屏，这也是 Mac 首次用上 OLED。

The body incorporates the Dynamic Island element familiar to iPhone users, offering two sizes, 14-inch and 16-inch, with prices significantly higher than the current models starting at $2499. 机身加入 iPhone 用户熟悉的灵动岛元素，提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸两种尺寸，价格将明显高于现款 2499 美元起的机型。

Reports indicate that Apple's internal CEO John Ternus and Tim Cook both believe users have begun to expect Mac to support touch, but the industrial design team still holds an opposing view, ultimately compromising on 'touch is an option, not the primary interaction method'. 报道称，苹果内部的 CEO 约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）和蒂姆·库克（Tim Cook）都认为用户已开始期待 Mac 支持触控，但工业设计团队仍持反对态度，最终折中为「触控是选项，而非主要交互方式」。

To accommodate touch, macOS Golden Gate has been adjusted: the interface dynamically presents controls based on whether the user is touching the screen or using the trackpad, tapping buttons can bring up menus around the finger, and the Dock and menu bar have also been optimized for touch. 为配合触控，macOS Golden Gate 做了调整：界面会根据用户是在触摸屏幕还是使用触控板动态呈现控件，点按按钮可在手指周围弹出菜单，Dock 和菜单栏也针对触控做了优化。

The report points out that Apple has not yet solved the ergonomic problem mentioned by Jobs back then; users still need to raise their hands to operate a vertical screen, which becomes uncomfortable after a few seconds of use. 报道指出，苹果尚未解决乔布斯当年提到的人体工学问题，用户仍需抬手操作竖直屏幕，体验数秒后就会不适。

Additionally, Apple will also release a 14-inch entry-level MacBook Pro with an M6 chip and existing design, as well as a new non-OLED iMac this week; a redesigned 14-inch entry-level MacBook Pro is planned for next year, and a non-OLED MacBook Air update is expected early next year. 此外，苹果本周还将发布搭载 M6 芯片、沿用现有设计的 14 英寸入门款 MacBook Pro，以及一款非 OLED 的新 iMac；采用新设计的 14 英寸入门款 MacBook Pro 计划明年推出，非 OLED 的 MacBook Air 更新预计在明年初。

Reports indicate that Apple is testing OLED versions of the MacBook Air and iMac, but they will not be launched in the short term. 报道称，苹果正在测试 OLED 版 MacBook Air 和 iMac，但短期内不会推出。

item.title: iPhone Duo 开售不到两天即破发
item.description:
On October 25, 'iPhone Duo price drop' became a trending topic on Weibo, with many netizens reporting that the price of iPhone Duo on a certain platform had fallen below its initial release price. 10 月 25 日，「iPhone Duo 破发」登上微博热搜，多名网友反映，在某平台上 iPhone Duo 的价格已低于首发价。

A reporter from Xin Huanghe found that the estimated delivery time for some orders on Apple's official website is still scheduled for January next year, but offline dealers have already offered in-stock prices below the original price. Some consumers even bought the 256GB version, originally priced at 15999 yuan, for 15499 yuan through local subsidies. 新黄河记者发现，苹果官网部分订单的预计交付时间仍排到明年 1 月，但线下经销商已出现低于原价的现货报价。还有消费者通过地方补贴，以 15499 元买到了原价 15999 元的 256GB 版本。

Some external views suggest that the price drop is related to insufficient app adaptation, screen issues reported by early users, Apple's increased production capacity, and early shipment of some orders. 外界有观点认为，破发与应用适配不足、首批用户反馈的屏幕问题，以及苹果上调产能、部分订单提前发货有关。

item.title: 部分用户反馈 iPhone Duo 内屏开裂
item.guid: 部分用户反馈-iPhone-Duo-内屏开裂
item.description:
After the iPhone Duo went on sale, multiple reports of inner screen damage appeared on platforms like Reddit and MacRumors forums, with some photos showing cracks extending along the fold and accompanied by bright lines extending towards one side of the screen. iPhone Duo 开售后，Reddit、MacRumors 论坛等平台出现多起内屏损坏反馈，部分照片显示裂纹沿折叠处延伸，并伴有向屏幕一侧延伸的亮线。

Australian user Midnight_Slump stated that about 6 hours after receiving the phone and opening/closing it fewer than 20 times, he felt something unusual beneath the inner hinge when unfolding the screen to show a friend, followed by a cracking sound. 澳洲用户 Midnight_Slump 称，手机到手约 6 小时、开合不足 20 次，在向朋友展开屏幕时感到内铰链下方异样，随后听到裂声。

He stated that there were no obvious signs of bumps, scratches, or foreign objects caught in the inner screen surface or external hinge; upon visiting the store, Apple replaced his device on the spot. 他表示，内屏表面和外部铰链没有明显磕碰或异物夹入痕迹；到店后，苹果当场为其更换了新机。

After disassembling the iPhone Duo, iFixit combined CT scans, patents, and teardown images to build a hinge model, attempting to explain the inner screen damage reported by some users. iFixit 拆解 iPhone Duo 后，结合 CT 扫描、专利和拆解影像建立铰链模型，尝试解释部分用户的内屏损坏。

iFixit found that the damage locations in the publicly available photos were concentrated in the transition area between the cross-body cable gaps and the central hinge support, where multiple edges converge, altering how the flexible screen is supported when bent. iFixit 发现，公开照片中的损坏位置集中在跨机身排线间隙与中央铰链支撑的过渡区域，多条边缘在此交汇，改变了柔性屏弯折时的承托方式。

In one simulation, the central support rod did not descend low enough, causing the curved part of the screen to press against the support rod, potentially forming localized stress hotspots. 在其中一种模拟中，中央支撑杆没有降到足够低的位置，屏幕弯曲部分压上支撑杆，可能形成局部应力热点。

On the other hand, AppleInsider reported on October 24 that none of the 7 Apple stores they contacted, including 4 major flagship stores, had received any repairs or returns for inner screen cracks. The existing public cases are insufficient to determine whether the problem stems from usage, individual batch manufacturing, or design factors. 另一边，AppleInsider 于 10 月 24 日报道，其联系的 7 家苹果门店、包括 4 家主要旗舰店，尚未接到内屏破裂的送修或退货。现有公开案例不足以判断问题来自使用方式、个别批次制造，还是设计因素。

The estimated out-of-warranty repair cost for iPhone Duo inner screen damage listed on Apple China's official website is 7998 yuan; within the AppleCare+ coverage, the service fee for inner screen damage is 628 yuan. 苹果中国官网列出的 iPhone Duo 内屏损坏保外维修预估费用为 7998 元；在 AppleCare+ 保障范围内，内屏损坏服务费为 628 元。

item.title: 企业微信回应账号发送色情引流信息：第三方外挂被攻破，已强制下线受影响账号
item.guid: 企业微信回应账号发送色情引流信息：第三方外挂被攻破，已强制下线受影响账号
item.description:
On October 24, a small number of WeChat Work accounts sent suspected pornographic traffic-driving messages to customers. The WeChat Work security team stated in an announcement that after investigation, the incident was caused by a compromised third-party plugin software service, affecting accounts using that service; the platform has forcibly taken affected accounts offline and blocked related traffic-driving links. 10 月 24 日，少量企业微信账号向客户发送疑似色情引流信息。企业微信安全团队在公告中表示，经排查，事件由某第三方外挂软件服务被攻破引起，使用该服务的账号受到影响；平台已将受影响账号强制下线，并封禁相关引流链接。

The announcement warned that plugins marketed with features like 'multiple accounts' and 'group control' could lead to accounts being controlled by others and the leakage of enterprise data and customer information. WeChat Work requires enterprises and users currently using such software to immediately stop using it and investigate account security risks. 公告提醒，以「账号多开」「群控」为卖点的外挂，可能导致账号被他人操控、企业数据及客户信息泄露。企业微信要求正在使用此类软件的企业和用户立即停用，并排查账号安全隐患。

Subsequently, the platform will strengthen its ability to identify behaviors such as tampering with clients, bypassing security mechanisms, and circumventing usage restrictions, continuously clearing out plugins and their development and sales channels, and pursuing legal responsibility for relevant entities. For accounts using plugins, WeChat Work will take disciplinary actions according to platform agreements and the severity of violations. 后续平台将加强识别篡改客户端、绕过安全机制和使用限制等行为，持续清理外挂及其开发、销售渠道，并依法追究相关主体责任。对于使用外挂的账号，企业微信将按平台协议和违规情节采取处理措施。

item.title: OpenAI 给 AI 建「离线世界」，隔离模型仍用 CPU 缓存传话
item.guid: OpenAI-给-AI-建「离线世界」，隔离模型仍用-CPU-缓存传话
item.description:
On October 23, OpenAI announced a hardening plan for its frontier model training environment: models will practice searching and browsing in an 'offline world' composed of indexed, cached web pages, avoiding direct impact on the real internet. The company stated that all reinforcement learning training for frontier models has adopted this offline mode. OpenAI 在 10 月 23 日公布前沿模型训练环境的加固方案：让模型在索引、缓存的网页组成的「离线世界」里练习搜索和浏览，避免直接影响真实互联网。公司称，所有前沿模型的强化学习训练都已采用这种离线模式。

Isolation still has unexpected gaps. In a red team test, two Agents in different lightweight virtual machines, unable to connect to the internet or share writable files, used the same host machine's CPU cache to transmit synthetic secrets: one selectively evicted cache data, the other measured read speed, and then reconstructed the message according to a protocol. Most related tests provided hints on communication direction or encoding rules, belonging to offensive and defensive experiments actively arranged by researchers. 隔离仍有意想不到的缝隙。在一项红队测试中，两个 Agent 分处不同的轻量虚拟机，不能联网，也没有共享可写文件，却利用同一宿主机的 CPU 缓存传递了合成秘密：一方选择性地挤出缓存数据，另一方测量读取快慢，再按协议还原消息。多数相关测试提供了通信方向或编码规则提示，属于研究人员主动布置的攻防实验。

Another incident occurred during a training task on September 20, where the model itself made limited contact with the external network by exploiting a DNS configuration error. OpenAI subsequently paused the relevant training and evaluation, and after hardening, resumed frontier model reinforcement learning training and internal inference on October 1. The company stated that it has patched the discovered issues and increased monitoring for covert communication. 另一次发生在 9 月 20 日的训练任务中，模型自行利用 DNS 配置错误有限接触了外网。OpenAI 随后暂停相关训练和评估，加固后于 10 月 1 日恢复前沿模型强化学习训练及内部推理。公司表示，已修补发现的问题，并增加了对隐蔽通信的监控。

🔗 Related reading: OpenAI created a 'fake internet,' and two isolated AIs secretly communicated via CPU cache 🔗 相关阅读： OpenAI 造了个「假互联网」，两个被隔离的 AI 竟靠 CPU 缓存暗中传话

item.title: AI 越来越贵了，国内大模型均价上涨 98%
item.guid: AI-越来越贵了，国内大模型均价上涨-98%
item.description:
Recently, the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT) Artificial Intelligence Research Institute and other institutions jointly released the 'Large Model Token Service Performance Monitoring Report (2026)'. The report shows that after two years of price wars, the prices of large model services both domestically and internationally have significantly rebounded this year. 日前，中国信通院人工智能研究所等机构联合发布《大模型词元服务性能监测报告（2026 年）》。报告显示，经历过去两年的价格战后，国内外大模型服务价格在今年明显回升。

Among them, the normalized average price of domestic large model services rose from 6.8 yuan in the second half of 2025 to 13.46 yuan this year, an increase of nearly 98% . In contrast, the average normalized price of typical foreign models released since 2026 is approximately 117.8 yuan, still nearly 9 times that of domestic models. 其中，国内大模型服务的归一化均价从 2025 年下半年的 6.8 元上涨至今年以来的 13.46 元， 涨幅接近 98%。 相比之下，2026 年以来发布的国外典型模型平均归一化价格约为 117.8 元，仍是国内的近 9 倍。

While prices are rising, the usage of large models is also growing rapidly. The report points out that in June this year, the average daily consumption of Tokens in China reached approximately 500 trillion, nearly 4 times that of December last year. Service performance has also improved, with domestic models averaging 78.23 Tokens per second in August this year, doubling the average level of 2025. 价格上涨的同时，大模型的使用量也在快速增长。报告指出，今年 6 月，国内 Token 日均消耗量达到约 500 万亿，是去年 12 月的近 4 倍。服务性能也有所提升，今年 8 月国内模型平均每秒输出 78.23 个 Token，较 2025 年的平均水平实现翻倍。

item.title: 曝小云雀并入即梦，字节收拢 AI 视频应用资源
item.guid: 曝小云雀并入即梦，字节收拢-AI-视频应用资源
item.description:
According to a report by 'Intelligent Emergence' on October 24, CapCut (Jianying) recently completed an internal business integration, with the AI short drama creation platform Xiaoyunque merging into Jiemeng. The product still retains an independent entry point. Jiemeng has integrated Xiaoyunque's short drama-related capabilities, and Xiaoyunque's operations are now managed by Jiemeng's operations and marketing head, Chen Xinran, with no changes to the product team. 据《智能涌现》10 月 24 日报道，剪映内部近期完成业务整合，AI 短剧创作平台小云雀并入即梦，产品仍保留独立入口。即梦已接入小云雀的短剧相关能力，小云雀运营改由即梦运营和市场负责人陈欣然负责，产品团队没有变化。

This round of integration is also accompanied by adjustments within Jiemeng itself. Citing informed sources, the report states that before the National Day holiday this year, Jiemeng had reduced investment in its App, promoting the merger of its App and Web versions. Future resources will be concentrated on the Web version for professional creators, and investment in the overseas version Dreamina and commercialization will be increased. 这轮整合还伴随着即梦自身的调整。报道援引知情人士称，今年国庆前，即梦已缩减 App 端投入，推动 App 与 Web 端合并，未来资源将集中到面向专业创作者的 Web 端，并加大海外版 Dreamina 及商业化投入。

A former CapCut (Jianying) employee told the media that while Jiemeng and Xiaoyunque are still growing, user growth has not yet translated into returns commensurate with the investment; the increase in external video Agent products is also compressing the differentiation space for their own applications. The report also stated that for the Seedance series models, Volcano's model service revenue has surpassed that of products like Jiemeng and Xiaoyunque. 一位前剪映人士向该媒体表示，即梦、小云雀虽然仍在增长，但用户增长尚未转化为与投入相匹配的回报；外部视频 Agent 产品的增加，也在压缩自有应用的差异化空间。报道同时称，在 Seedance 系列模型上，火山的模型服务收入已高于即梦、小云雀等产品。

item.title: Reddit 开源社区禁止 AI 项目，连 AI 翻译发帖也被排除
item.guid: Reddit-开源社区禁止-AI-项目，连-AI-翻译发帖也被排除
item.description:
Reddit's r/opensource community has begun to tighten its project promotion rules. Administrator Wolvereness announced that projects that use AI, are made by AI, or serve AI are no longer welcome in the community, and MCP-type projects are also excluded. This is a management decision by the subreddit. Reddit 的 r/opensource 社区开始收紧项目推广规则。管理员 Wolvereness 在公告中表示，使用 AI、由 AI 制作，或为 AI 服务的项目，都不再受该社区欢迎，MCP 类项目也被列入排除范围。这是该子社区的管理决定。

The new rules also require that promoted projects have been continuously maintained for at least one year, have multiple contributors and an existing community, and continue to use an OSI-approved open-source license. The announcement suggests a minimum of 3 contributors and no longer accepts posts seeking maintainers or recruiting contributors. 新规则还要求，推广项目至少已持续维护一年、拥有多位贡献者和现成社区，并继续使用 OSI 认可的开源许可证。公告给出的贡献者参考人数为至少 3 人，也不再接受寻找维护者或招募贡献者的帖子。

Language requirements also sparked controversy. Administrators stated that they cannot distinguish between AI writing and AI translation, so users who do not speak English should seek other communities. In the original post's comments, multiple users questioned whether this would exclude non-English speaking developers, and independent project maintainers also opposed the multi-contributor threshold. 语言要求同样引发争议。管理员称，无法区分 AI 写作与 AI 翻译，因此不会英语的用户应寻找其他社区。原帖评论中，多位用户质疑这会排斥非英语开发者，独立维护项目的开发者也反对多贡献者门槛。

According to The Verge, administrators later stated that there is still room for exceptions during enforcement, such as software with accessibility features like AI-generated automatic subtitles. Following the controversy, another community, r/TrueOpenSource, has been established, and the original announcement has been updated with a link to this community. 据 The Verge 报道，管理员随后表示执行时仍有例外空间，例如附带 AI 自动字幕等无障碍功能的软件。争议后，另一个社区 r/TrueOpenSource 已成立，原公告也补上了指向该社区的说明。

item.title: 马斯克称 SpaceX 完成 400 亿美元债务融资，用于采购 GPU
item.guid: 马斯克称-SpaceX-完成-400-亿美元债务融资，用于采购-GPU
item.description:
Elon Musk stated that SpaceX has completed $40 billion in debt financing to purchase GPUs. According to Reuters, he attributed the successful financing to the company's investment-grade credit and revenue from its Starlink satellite internet and rocket launch businesses. 马斯克表示，SpaceX 已完成 400 亿美元债务融资，用于购买 GPU。据路透社报道，他将融资成功归因于公司的投资级信用，以及 Starlink 卫星互联网和火箭发射业务带来的收入。

He stated that this financing is primarily for callable debt, and the corresponding GPUs will be delivered in the first and second quarters of next year, with little impact on the current quarter. Reuters reported earlier this month that SpaceX was in talks with banks and asset managers for this chip procurement financing. 他称，这笔融资主要是可提前赎回债务，对应的 GPU 将于明年第一、第二季度交付，对本季度影响不大。路透社本月稍早曾报道，SpaceX 正与银行和资产管理机构商谈这笔芯片采购融资。

Regarding the market environment, Musk believes that companies without substantial revenue beyond AI data centers are largely shut out of the debt market. He predicts that new cloud service providers specializing in providing computing power for AI clients will see consolidation and bankruptcies, and stated that SpaceX will not acquire these companies. 谈到市场环境，马斯克认为，没有 AI 数据中心以外大量收入的企业，几乎已被债务市场挡在门外。他预计，专为 AI 客户提供算力的新型云服务商将出现整合与倒闭，并表示 SpaceX 不会收购这些企业。

'Completed financing' is Musk's description of the deal's status. Reuters noted that his post does not yet indicate whether the debt's pricing has been finalized with investors. 「完成融资」是马斯克对交易状态的表述。路透社指出，其帖文尚不能说明债务是否已与投资者敲定定价。

item.title: 蓝思科技第三季度净利润降逾五成，前三季汇兑损失推高财务费用
item.guid: 蓝思科技第三季度净利润降逾五成，前三季汇兑损失推高财务费用
item.description:
Lens Technology disclosed its Q3 2026 report, with single-quarter operating revenue of 19.035 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 8.05%; net profit attributable to shareholders was 843 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 50.42%. After deducting non-recurring gains and losses, the net profit attributable to shareholders was 720 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 59.13%. 蓝思科技披露 2026 年第三季度报告，单季营业收入 190.35 亿元，同比下降 8.05%；归母净利润 8.43 亿元，同比下降 50.42%。扣除非经常性损益后，归母净利润为 7.20 亿元，同比下降 59.13%。

For the first three quarters, the company's operating revenue was 47.902 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 10.74%; net profit attributable to shareholders was 1.420 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 50.06%. Net cash flow from operating activities during the same period was 4.713 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 19.35%. This quarterly financial report is unaudited. 前三季度，公司营业收入为 479.02 亿元，同比下降 10.74%；归母净利润 14.20 亿元，同比下降 50.06%。同期经营活动产生的现金流量净额为 47.13 亿元，同比下降 19.35%。这份季度财务报告未经审计。

The report explained that financial expenses in the first three quarters increased to 716 million yuan, mainly due to increased net exchange losses. Inventory at the end of the period increased by 35.02% compared to the beginning of the year, with the company stating that the second half of the year is the peak sales season, and inventory preparation increased accordingly; the growth in construction in progress mainly came from investment in the Lens Technology Dongyuan project. 报告解释，前三季度财务费用增至 7.16 亿元，主要由于汇兑净损失增加。期末存货较年初增长 35.02%，公司称下半年为销售旺季，备货相应增加；在建工程增长则主要来自蓝思科技东园建设项目投入。

item.title: 💡 阿波罗首席经济学家：AI 回报还没体现在科技业以外的利润率上
item.guid: 💡-阿波罗首席经济学家：AI-回报还没体现在科技业以外的利润率上
item.description:
Torsten Slok, Chief Economist at Apollo Global Management, stated in his signed column on October 24 that U.S. companies outside the tech industry have not yet shown financial returns from AI. He compared the tech "Magnificent Seven" with the remaining 493 companies in the S&P 500 index: the former saw an increase in per capita revenue and profit margins, while the latter's relevant indicators remained relatively flat. 阿波罗全球管理公司首席经济学家 Torsten Slok 在 10 月 24 日的署名专栏中提出，科技行业之外的美国企业，尚未显现 AI 带来的财务回报。他将科技「七巨头」与标普 500 指数其余 493 家公司作比较：前者的人均营收和利润率上升，后者的相关指标仍较平。

Slok believes that venture-backed companies are continuously increasing token spending, but mainstream enterprises may not need the latest models and are unwilling to pay for them. If investments are not reflected in operating results, token fees can easily be seen as a cost that reduces profit margins. As long as agents and related expenditures remain concentrated in a small part of the economy, the macro impact of AI will be limited. Slok 认为，风投支持的企业在持续增加 Token 支出，但主流企业未必需要最新模型，也不愿为其付费。如果投入没有反映在经营结果上，Token 费用就容易被当作压低利润率的成本。只要智能体和相关支出仍集中在经济的一小部分，AI 的宏观影响就会有限。

He then suggested that even if model prices decrease, companies still need to convert cheaper intelligence into revenue and profit growth. 他接着提出，即便模型价格下降，企业仍要把更便宜的智能转化为营收和利润增长。

Business judgment relies on specific contexts and involves accountability, trust, culture, unwritten rules, and ethical trade-offs; he believes that AI still lacks understanding of these factors. Slok therefore considers the operating indicators of the remaining 493 companies as important evidence for evaluating AI returns, as the growth of tech giants alone is not representative of other industries. 商业判断依赖具体情境，也涉及问责、信任、文化、未成文规则和伦理取舍；他认为，AI 对这些因素的理解仍有欠缺。Slok 因而将其余 493 家企业的经营指标视为检验 AI 回报的重要依据，科技巨头的增长不足以代表其他行业。

item.title: 大众与众 09 上市：限时 16.99 万元起，5 米轿跑用上 5C 超充
item.guid: 大众与众-09-上市：限时-16.99-万元起，5-米轿跑用上-5C-超充
item.description:
According to information obtained by Autohome from Volkswagen Anhui, the Yu Zhong 09 was launched on October 24, offering 3 configurations with guide prices ranging from 179,900 yuan to 249,900 yuan. The Ultra version with the Obsidian Black color scheme can enjoy a Double Eleven surprise price of 169,900 yuan. 据汽车之家从大众安徽获得的信息，与众 09 于 10 月 24 日上市，推出 3 款配置，指导价为 17.99 万元至 24.99 万元，其中 Ultra 版耀夜黑配色可享双十一惊喜价 16.99 万元。

The new car features a fastback coupe design, with a length of 5081mm and a wheelbase of 3030mm. The cockpit is equipped with an independent instrument screen, a floating central control screen, and an 85-inch AR-HUD. It also offers a full-scene intelligent assisted driving system based on the VLA large model, supporting functions such as custom parking, exit parking, remote parking, and trajectory reversing. 新车采用溜背轿跑造型，车长 5081mm、轴距 3030mm。座舱配备独立仪表屏、悬浮式中控屏和 85 英寸 AR-HUD，并提供基于 VLA 大模型的全场景智能辅助驾驶系统，支持自定义泊车、离车泊入、遥控泊车和循迹倒车等功能。

The powertrain is divided into single-motor rear-wheel drive and dual-motor four-wheel drive: the rear-wheel drive motor has a maximum power of 230kW, while the front and rear motors of the four-wheel drive version are 140kW and 230kW, respectively. Both are equipped with approximately 92kWh CATL lithium iron phosphate batteries, with CLTC ranges of 755 kilometers and 705 kilometers, respectively. The vehicle adopts an 800V high-voltage platform and 5C supercharging technology, and offers dual-chamber air suspension. 动力分为单电机后驱和双电机四驱：后驱电机最大功率 230kW，四驱版前后电机分别为 140kW、230kW。两者搭载约 92kWh 宁德时代磷酸铁锂电池，CLTC 续航分别为 755 公里和 705 公里。车辆采用 800V 高压平台与 5C 超充技术，并提供双腔空气悬架。

item.title: CapCut 将接入 ChatGPT，11 月面向手机、桌面和网页端公测
item.guid: CapCut-将接入-ChatGPT，11-月面向手机、桌面和网页端公测
item.description:
CapCut announced at the CapCut World event in Los Angeles that it will integrate its video generation and editing tools as plugins into ChatGPT. The official demo video indicates that the public beta is planned to cover mobile, desktop, and web platforms in November. CapCut 在洛杉矶举行的 CapCut World 活动上宣布，将把视频生成和编辑工具以插件形式接入 ChatGPT。官方演示视频标明，公开测试计划于 11 月覆盖移动端、桌面端和网页端。

According to the process announced by CapCut, users can describe their ideas in ChatGPT, have the plugin generate a video draft, and then bring the project to the CapCut web editor for further adjustments, sharing, and publishing. The conversation initiates the production, while subsequent fine-tuning can still be completed on the timeline. 按照 CapCut 公布的流程，用户可以在 ChatGPT 中描述创意，由插件生成视频初稿，再把项目带到 CapCut 网页编辑器中继续调整、分享和发布。对话负责发起制作，后续的精细编辑仍可回到时间线完成。

CapCut officially released an announcement in the early morning of October 25 Beijing time, using the phrase "coming soon." The Los Angeles event was held on October 24 local time; this announcement covers the cross-platform public beta schedule. CapCut 官方于北京时间 10 月 25 日凌晨发布公告，使用的是「即将推出」的表述。洛杉矶场活动于当地时间 10 月 24 日举行；这次公布的是跨端公测安排。

item.title: 猛士 X700 上市，限时焕新价 20.98 万元起
item.guid: 猛士-X700-上市，限时焕新价-20.98-万元起
item.description:
Mengshi Automobile's X700 was officially launched on October 25, offering four configurations with guide prices ranging from 219,800 yuan to 279,800 yuan, and a limited-time refresh price of 209,800 yuan to 269,800 yuan. The new car is the first model in the Mengshi X series, positioned as a luxury smart all-terrain SUV, and features a unibody construction. 猛士汽车旗下 X700 于 10 月 25 日正式上市，共推出四款配置，指导价为 21.98 万元至 27.98 万元，限时焕新价为 20.98 万元至 26.98 万元。新车是猛士 X 系列首款车型，定位豪华智慧全地形 SUV，采用承载式车身。

The X700 is equipped with Huawei Qiankun Smart Driving ADS 5 and HarmonyOS Cockpit HarmonySpace 6. In terms of configuration, the rear-wheel drive Pro and four-wheel drive Max, Max+ adopt a 400V platform, while the four-wheel drive Ultra is upgraded to an 800V platform and features dual-chamber air suspension; MRC magnetorheological shock absorbers are available from the four-wheel drive Max. The new car is designed for both family use and light off-road scenarios. X700 搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 和鸿蒙座舱 HarmonySpace 6。配置上，后驱 Pro 与四驱 Max、Max+ 采用 400V 平台，四驱 Ultra 升级为 800V 平台，并配备双腔空气悬架；MRC 磁流变减震器从四驱 Max 提供。新车同时面向家庭用车和轻越野场景。

item.title: 八位堂《古墓丽影》30 周年手柄开售，把劳拉与失落山谷做成两种设计
item.guid: 八位堂《古墓丽影》30-周年手柄开售，把劳拉与失落山谷做成两种设计
item.description:
8BitDo launched the "Tomb Raider" 30th-anniversary co-branded controllers on October 24, including the Orion 3 Xbox version and the Pro 3 Bluetooth controller, priced at 549 yuan and 399 yuan respectively in China. 八位堂 10 月 24 日推出《古墓丽影》30 周年联名手柄，包含猎户座 3 代 Xbox 版和 Pro 3 蓝牙手柄，国内售价分别为 549 元、399 元。

The two products draw on different series memories: the Orion 3 incorporates Lara Croft's images from different eras into a single design, while the Pro 3 takes the "Lost Valley" theme from the original game, integrating ruin textures and jungle elements. The first "Tomb Raider" game was released in 1996, and Lara's adventures have continued for 30 years. 两款产品选择了不同的系列记忆：猎户座 3 代将不同时代的劳拉形象放在同一设计中，Pro 3 则以初代作品的「失落山谷」为主题，融入遗迹纹理与丛林元素。《古墓丽影》首作诞生于 1996 年，劳拉的冒险至今已延续 30 年。

The Orion 3 features adjustable resistance TMR joysticks, Hall effect triggers, and back buttons, supporting wireless connection to Xbox consoles and platforms like PC. The symmetrically laid out Pro 3 also uses TMR joysticks, equipped with trigger mode switching and magnetically interchangeable ABXY buttons, compatible with platforms such as Switch, Switch 2, Windows, SteamOS, Apple, and Android. The official co-branded page already provides purchasing portals for various channels in China. 猎户座 3 代采用可调阻力的 TMR 摇杆、霍尔扳机与背键，支持 Xbox 主机无线连接，以及 PC 等平台。对称布局的 Pro 3 也采用 TMR 摇杆，配备扳机模式切换和可互换布局的磁吸 ABXY 按键，兼容 Switch、Switch 2、Windows、SteamOS、Apple 和 Android 等平台。官方联名页面已提供国内各渠道购买入口。

item.title: 致态联名《影之刃零》，TiPlus9100 固态硬盘加入武侠礼盒
item.guid: 致态联名《影之刃零》，TiPlus9100-固态硬盘加入武侠礼盒
item.description:
ZhiTai announced a strategic partnership with "Phantom Blade Zero" to launch a co-branded gift box for the TiPlus9100 solid-state drive. Both parties announced the collaboration on October 24 at Shougang Park in Beijing and set up a co-branded exhibition area at the Nuclear Fusion exhibition. 致态宣布与《影之刃零》达成战略合作，推出 TiPlus9100 固态硬盘联名礼盒。双方于 10 月 24 日在北京首钢园公布合作，并在核聚变展会设置联名展区。

This collaboration combines storage hardware with the visual design of a Wuxia game. In the exhibition photos released by ZhiTai, the calligraphy, characters, and red line array from "Phantom Blade Zero" formed the main backdrop; on October 25, the brand continued to showcase the TiPlus9100 and the co-branded gift box at the exhibition, inviting players to participate in the experience. 这次联名把存储硬件与武侠游戏的视觉设计结合。致态公开的展台照片中，《影之刃零》的题字、角色与红色线阵成为布景主体；10 月 25 日，品牌继续在展会现场展示 TiPlus9100 与联名礼盒，邀请玩家参与体验。

item.title: 《复仇者联盟 5》发布棒球赛特别预告，神奇先生登场开球
item.guid: 《复仇者联盟-5》发布棒球赛特别预告，神奇先生登场开球
item.description:
Marvel and Major League Baseball (MLB) released a special trailer for "Avengers 5" during the first game of the World Series. Pedro Pascal, playing Mister Fantastic, walked onto the pitcher's mound to throw the ceremonial first pitch for Joseph Quinn, playing Human Torch. 漫威与美国职业棒球大联盟 MLB 在世界大赛首场比赛期间，发布《复仇者联盟 5》的特别预告。佩德罗·帕斯卡饰演的神奇先生走上投手丘，为约瑟夫·奎恩饰演的霹雳火投出开场球。

According to Deadline, new footage also showed Chris Evans as Steve Rogers. After seeing him, Ant-Man was confused about who should be called "Captain America" — as Anthony Mackie's Sam Wilson has now also taken up the shield. 据 Deadline 报道，新画面还出现了克里斯·埃文斯饰演的史蒂夫·罗杰斯。蚁人看到他后，对该把谁叫作「美国队长」感到困惑——安东尼·麦凯饰演的山姆·威尔逊如今也已接过盾牌。

The film will revolve around a multiverse crisis, with heroes from different Earths teaming up to fight Doctor Doom, played by Robert Downey Jr. Thor, Shang-Chi, Black Panther, and several X-Men characters will also appear, with a North American release date of December 18. 影片将围绕多元宇宙危机展开，来自不同地球的英雄联手对抗小罗伯特·唐尼饰演的毁灭博士。雷神、尚气、黑豹以及 X 战警中的多位角色也将登场，北美档期为 12 月 18 日。

item.title: 《三体・智子灾变》官宣，路阳监制、忻钰坤执导
item.guid: 《三体・智子灾变》官宣，路阳监制、忻钰坤执导
item.description:
The Three-Body Universe announced a new series, "The Three-Body Problem: Sophon Catastrophe," during its Three-Body Day event on October 24, with Lu Yang as producer and Xin Yukun as director, and released its first concept poster. 三体宇宙在 10 月 24 日的三体日活动中公布全新剧集《三体・智子灾变》，由路阳监制、忻钰坤执导，并发布首张概念海报。

The series focuses on the younger generation amidst the Three-Body crisis: the world is enveloped by a countdown, familiar order gradually breaks down, and the story revolves around ordinary people's choices when facing the unknown. The official synopsis describes it as a story of more "nameless ones" under a civilization crisis. 剧集将视角放在三体危机下的年轻一代：全球被倒计时笼罩，熟悉的世界逐渐失序，故事围绕普通人面对未知时的抉择展开。官方将其概括为文明危机之下更多「无名者」的故事。

On the same day, "The Three-Body Problem: Da Shi" also announced production progress, with filming planned to begin in the fourth quarter of 2026. Shi Qiang and Wang Miao will continue to work together, extending the investigation storyline and expanding on character and worldview narratives. 同日，《三体・大史》也公布制作进展，计划于 2026 年第四季度开机。史强与汪淼将继续携手，延续查案主线，并展开更多人物与世界观叙事。

item.title: 《天作不合的我们》主创再开发新剧，Hulu 将改编 These Summer Storms
item.guid: 《天作不合的我们》主创再开发新剧，Hulu-将改编-These-Summer-Storms
item.description:
According to an exclusive report by Deadline, "The Unqualified" creators Erin Foster and Sara Foster are developing the drama series "These Summer Storms" for Hulu, adapted from Sarah MacLean's novel of the same name, to be published in 2025. 据 Deadline 独家报道，《天作不合的我们》主创 Erin Foster 与 Sara Foster 正为 Hulu 开发剧情剧 These Summer Storms，改编自 Sarah MacLean 于 2025 年出版的同名小说。

The story revolves around Alice Storm: after being exiled by her family, she hasn't set foot on the family's private island off the coast of Rhode Island for five years, having built a life for herself beyond the family name and fortune. Her father's sudden death breaks this distance. 故事围绕 Alice Storm 展开：她被家族逐出后，已有五年未踏上罗得岛海岸外的家族私人岛屿，并在家族姓氏与财富之外建立了自己的生活。父亲突然去世，打破了这段距离。

The project is written by Melanie Marnich, developer of "The Affair" and showrunner, who will also serve as executive producer alongside the Foster sisters and the original author, among others, with 20th Television producing. MacLean stated that she looks forward to bringing the chaos of the Storm family to the screen. The Foster sisters' "The Unqualified" Season 3 premiered on Netflix that week, and the new project is currently in development. 项目由《不解之缘》开发者、剧集运作人 Melanie Marnich 编剧，她也将与 Foster 姐妹及原著作者等共同担任执行制片人，20th Television 负责制作。MacLean 在声明中称，期待把 Storm 家族的混乱搬上屏幕。Foster 姐妹的《天作不合的我们》第三季已于当周在 Netflix 上线，新项目目前处于开发阶段。
